profile.description: Toà nhà bệnh viện dưới mưa đêm, ban đêm, mưa, ô cửa đỏ. Four-storey hospital block at night in heavy rain: grid of barred windows (top floor pale teal, lower floors mixed warm-lit and dark), cracks on the facade, roof sign DISTRICT HOSPITAL, blue MEMORIAL WING sign over the entrance, trees, street lamp, wet road and parked scooters. Variant redwindow: the last top-floor window glows red.
